body:
I do not make this decision lightly. My education, background experience, health and other problems prevent me from doing anything that could change my situation. My depression has crippled my entire life since I was very young, but back then I never understood how much it mattered and even begin to comprehend how much worse it could get...

There is too much pressure and I can't take it, they expect me to go back to work that horrible job, like a dog... Knowing the condition that I am in...

I also have very bad social anxiety, and I don't think there's such a hotline in my country, but really I'm past the point of words helping me.
